profileSummary.text: Fullstack engineer with 1+ year of production experience on meeting-processing and IoT products. Works across backend services in Node.js, Go, and Python with PostgreSQL and the web and mobile interfaces on top of them, including integration and production troubleshooting inside a cross-functional team.

projects.narrative: Built a coding agent workspace in Nuxt and Rust where the AI proposes file edits and shell commands, and a native Rust relay runs them inside a Bubblewrap sandbox under explicit permission rules. Each action returns its diff, test output, and Git state, so a claimed fix can be checked.

Built Rust and Axum services on PostgreSQL for courses, enrollment, and lesson completion, instrumented with OpenTelemetry and Prometheus. Learner progress is stored apart from the game and story layer, so dashboards can show the next lesson while public course pages stay separate from private progress.

Built an IoT management platform in Node.js with Hapi, PostgreSQL, MQTT, and EMQX. It records requested commands apart from reported device state so the UI shows what was asked versus what the device did, checks device ownership before any control, and traces the command flow with OpenTelemetry.

Built a reusable authentication service in Rust and Actix-web with PostgreSQL, JWT sessions, and Argon2 password hashing. One account can belong to several tenants with a different role in each; RocksDB caching and Docker packaging support the runtime.

employmentBullets: Built recording upload and progress-feedback flows for Sensio Notes across web and mobile, including recovery after interrupted uploads.
Built backend and control-feedback flows for Sensio IoT, connecting user commands to device state, and worked on application reliability.
Implemented UI/UX designs as working web and mobile features and worked with AI and IoT engineers on integration.
Diagnosed application failures and supported testing and releases with infrastructure and security engineers.
